Peak-picking for an m/z range

pickPeaksMzRange.Rd

Function will pick chromatographic peaks in the raw data file by binning and analyzing the extracted ion chromatograms.

Usage 

pickPeaksMzRange(
  daten,
  mz_min,
  mz_max,
  mz_step,
  rt_min,
  rt_max,
  sn,
  int_threshold,
  peak_NoiseScans,
  precursormzTol,
  peakwidth_min,
  peakwidth_max,
  maxPeaksPerSignal
)

Arguments

daten

Measurement data of class `xcms::xcmsRAW`

mz_min

m/z range to peak-picking (lower) (Da)

mz_max

m/z range to peak-picking (upper) (Da)

mz_step

m/z width for extracted ion chromatogram (Da)

rt_min

Retention time range minimum in which to look for peaks (s)

rt_max

Retention time range maximum in which to look for peaks (s)

sn

Minimum signal-to-noise ratio (apex peak height over noise spread before and after peak)

int_threshold

Minimum peak intensity (at peak apex)

peak_NoiseScans

Number of scans before and after peak to measure noise

precursormzTol

m/z tolerance for linking MS2 fragment spectra by the precursor m/z (ppm)

peakwidth_min

Minimum peak width given (s)

peakwidth_max

Maximum peak width given (s)

maxPeaksPerSignal

Maximum number of sub-peaks within a peak (direction changes) within a peak

Value

`data.frame` of the peak inventory (peak table)
